name: Commercial Floor Cleaner – 5L
description: Low-foam, streak-free commercial floor cleaning solution formulated for daily maintenance across tiled, marble, vinyl, and sealed concrete floors in high-traffic business premises.
applications: Recommended for daily lobby, corridor, washroom, and back-of-house floor care in office buildings, hotels, schools, and commercial facilities across Dubai and the UAE.
usageSafety: Always follow label dilution instructions and wear standard protective gloves during handling. Commercial Safety Data Sheets (SDS) are provided on order confirmation.
packagingDetails: Supplied in tamper-evident 5L HDPE jerrycans, individually or in 4 × 5L corrugated commercial cases for palletized UAE delivery.

name: Liquid Hand Wash – 5L
description: Gentle moisturizing commercial liquid hand soap bulk refill designed for high-traffic office washrooms, clinics, hospitality venues, and residential buildings.
applications: Refills wall-mounted commercial soap dispensers in offices, malls, restaurants, and apartment lobbies.
usageSafety: External skin cleansing use only. Store upright in a cool dry janitorial closet.

name: Multipurpose Cleaner – 5L
description: Neutral pH all-purpose spray and wipe concentrate engineered for desks, countertops, painted walls, chrome fixtures, and pantry surfaces without leaving residue.
applications: Ideal for workstations, reception desks, elevator interiors, break rooms, and residential kitchens.
usageSafety: Dilute into labeled trigger bottles before spraying. Avoid direct eye contact and keep sealed away from direct heat.
packagingDetails: Available as individual 5L jerrycans or 4 × 5L cartons.

name: Microfiber Cleaning Cloth – Pack of 10
description: Color-coded 320 GSM commercial microfiber cloths that trap fine dust and grease without scratching glass, stainless steel, or lacquered cabinetry.
applications: Color-coded zone cleaning: blue for general glass/desks, green for kitchens, yellow for washroom sinks, red for sanitary zones.
usageSafety: Wash separately without fabric softener to preserve electrostatic fiber lift.
packagingDetails: Sealed poly-pack of 10 cloths ready for janitorial cart deployment.

name: Industrial Cleaning Gloves
description: Powder-free nitrile chemical-resistant utility gloves with textured fingertips for confident wet grip during janitorial and sanitizing operations.
applications: Chemical dilution, washroom sanitation, waste handling, and food-prep facility cleaning.
usageSafety: Single-shift disposable PPE; inspect for tears before handling concentrates.

name: Heavy Duty Garbage Bags – Pack
description: Puncture-resistant high-density commercial bin liners built for heavy facility waste, pantry bins, and janitorial trolley collection across busy UAE buildings.
applications: Commercial waste stations, pantries, washroom bins, and residential chutes.
usageSafety: Keep plastic bags away from children and high-temperature heat sources.
packagingDetails: Compact coreless roll of 50 bags; master cartons contain 10 rolls.

name: Professional Mop & Bucket Set
description: Heavy-duty 32L side-press wringer mop bucket on smooth non-marking swivel casters, paired with an aluminum handle and high-absorbency looped cotton-blend mop head.
applications: Commercial corridors, building lobbies, clinics, restaurants, and warehouse floors.
usageSafety: Pair with wet floor caution signage during active mopping.
packagingDetails: Ships boxed with bucket, wringer assembly, handle, and 2 mop heads.

name: Toilet Cleaner – 5L
description: Thickened cling-action sanitary bowl and urinal descaler formulated to remove hard-water scale, organic stains, and odors in commercial washrooms.
applications: Office washrooms, hospitality restrooms, schools, and public buildings.
usageSafety: Do not mix with chlorine bleach or alkaline cleaners. Wear nitrile gloves.
packagingDetails: 5L HDPE jerrycan with directional pouring neck.

name: Jumbo Roll Toilet Tissue – Case
description: 2-ply virgin pulp jumbo toilet tissue rolls engineered for high-capacity commercial washroom dispensers, reducing refill frequency for building teams.
applications: High-footfall office towers, shopping venues, clinics, and commercial facilities.
usageSafety: Store cases elevated off floor in dry storage rooms.
packagingDetails: Sealed corrugated case of 12 × 300m jumbo rolls.

name: C-Fold & Interfold Hand Towels – Case
description: High-absorbency 2-ply embossed interfold paper hand towels designed for one-at-a-time hygienic dispensing in office and hospitality washrooms.
applications: Executive washrooms, pantry sinks, clinics, and commercial restrooms.

name: Commercial Janitorial Service Trolley
description: Three-tier commercial housekeeping and janitorial cart with front mop platform, zippered 100L vinyl waste bag, and quiet-roll swivel wheels.
applications: Multi-floor office buildings, hotels, hospitals, and facility contractors.
usageSafety: Lock front casters when parked on ramps or service elevators.
packagingDetails: Flat-packed commercial carton with 10-minute tool-free assembly.

name: Wet Floor Caution A-Frame Sign (Pack of 2)
description: High-visibility bilingual Arabic/English folding yellow caution A-frame safety signs compliant with UAE commercial facility safety protocols.
applications: Lobbies, escalators, washroom entrances, and wet maintenance zones.
usageSafety: Place clearly ahead of wet floor boundaries.
